Per review (Zippelius 2025, Nat Rev Cancer): nectin-4 expression in salivary glands drives the dysgeusia AE (~40% of EV-treated patients), a textbook on-target/off-tumour toxicity that also underpins broader off-tumour effects. This caps how far EV dose intensity can be pushed and cannot be solved by better linker/payload engineering alone — next-gen nectin-4 ADCs need tumour-selectivity gating (AND-gate bispecifics), lower DAR with more potent payload, or alternative payload classes. EV design context: MMAE microtubule payload (membrane-permeable, bystander-active), DAR ~3.8, protease-cleavable hinge disulfide linker, IgG1 backbone. Source: s41568-025-00869-w.pdf (DOI 10.1038/s41568-025-00869-w), p.927/933

unmet_needs.need: ADC-ICI synergy attribution gap (EV-302 trial design)
unmet_needs.notes: Per review (Zippelius 2025): the EV-302 design (no EV-monotherapy arm) means the field cannot quantify the incremental contribution of pembrolizumab vs enfortumab vedotin alone. A prior randomised phase II did show meaningful incremental benefit from adding pembro to EV. Future urothelial ADC trials should consider monotherapy arms for clean attribution. Source: s41568-025-00869-w.pdf, p.940

review_framing_notes: ADC+ICI combination biology (EV+pembro) — review framing (Zippelius 2025, Nat Rev Cancer): The EV-302 win (front-line EV+pembro in advanced urothelial) is the ONLY currently approved ADC-ICI combination across all of oncology. Biological rationale: MMAE payload induces immunogenic cell death (preclinical evidence across maytansinoid/auristatin/topoisomerase payload classes), preserved IgG1 Fc enables FcgammaR-driven dendritic-cell activation, and bystander killing in heterogeneous nectin-4 tumours expands antigen released for cross-presentation. The EV+pembro architecture is a template for ADC-ICI combos in other indications — urothelial is the precedent-setter. Source: s41568-025-00869-w.pdf, p.937-940

Urothelial as ADC-ICI precedent / franchise position — review framing (Zippelius 2025): EV+pembro being the only approved ADC+ICI combination as of late 2025 gives Pfizer/Astellas/Merck a precedent-setter franchise position; competitors entering urothelial ADC space (disitamab vedotin HER2+, sacituzumab govitecan/sac-TMT TROP2+, anti-HER3) will be benchmarked against it in both efficacy and the ADC+ICI combinability question. The EV+pembro precedent is being used to design ADC-ICI strategies in breast (mTNBC) and NSCLC. Source: s41568-025-00869-w.pdf, p.940
